text:
Maria: Hey team — after last night's KMS rekey we started seeing SCIM deprovision errors from idp-provisioner. ~120 accounts failing with 403 decrypt-failed for extId. Repro notes below.
Sam: Logs?
Maria: Paste from idp-provisioner (redacted):
```
2026-03-21T03:12:05Z idp-provisioner ERROR decrypt failed: kms.DecryptError: invalid envelope key alias: alias/redwood-2026-rekey
scim: user deprovision failed extId mismatch (jwe: decryption failure)
http 403 /provision
```
Emily: Is this only Okta or AAD too?
Maria: Mostly Okta batches; AAD looks fine. Pattern: older extIds encrypted with previous envelope key alias. Suspect the rekey rollout removed the service account's kms:Decrypt permission briefly. @Kevin can you confirm if the IAM change landed during the rotation window?
Kevin: Confirmed — CloudTrail shows a failed AttachRolePolicy call for service-account-provisioner at 02:58Z, right during the rekey. I re-attached kms-accessor role about 03:05Z. Might explain ~7 minute window of failures.
ops-bot: Incident created INC-2026-342 and paging oncall.
Sam: Short mitigation: add the previous envelope key alias as a fallback in KMS key policy for 30m so old JWE blobs can decrypt, then reprocess backlog. Need security signoff and audit trail.
security-bot: Vuln triage slot booked 2026-03-21 10:00 UTC. Added audit link: https://internal/logs/INC-2026-342.
Maria: Proposed action list:
1) Ensure service-account has kms:Decrypt (Kevin - done)
2) Temporarily enable legacy alias fallback (Ops)
3) Requeue deprovision jobs for affected window
4) Run audit to ensure no unauthorized RBAC changes + verify no leaked extIds
Who can run the requeue?
Kevin: I will requeue now that role is restored.
Maria: Requeue command (infra):
```
./infra/provisionerctl requeue --job-type=deprovision --since=2026-03-21T02:50Z
```
Sam: Monitoring: I'll watch success rate; alert if >5% still failing after requeue.
Emily: Postmortem items: require a canary rotation (test decrypt with service account before full alias swap), log IAM policy diffs with rotation ops, and add a short rollback playbook for KMS rekey.
Maria: Thanks everyone — I'll mark incident when all ~120 accounts processed. :thumbsup:
